invariants.rationale: Array indices are expected to be non-negative; negative columnIndex would cause an exception.
The method returns columnMinWidth[columnIndex], so result is exactly that value.
If sizeInvalid is true, computeSize() is called before accessing the array, ensuring its state is valid. (Assuming computeSizeCalledAfter is symbolic for context understanding.)
Array access requires columnIndex to be within bounds of the columnMinWidth array.
